description: Our new range of gravel bikes with aluminium frame was designed to provide maximum comfort and enjoyment on your regular rides.

components.description: Front thru axle 12x100mm M12x1.5
Rear thru axle 12x142mm M12.x1.5; Tubeless ready (kit not included)
BSA 68mm bottom bracket
TRP SPYRE double piston mechanical brakes; Front/rear TRP 160 mm centerlock front/rear discs
Microshift SWORD G-7000 brake levers; Semi-metallic TRP pads; Simultaneous actuation of two brake pads, combined with the ability to fine-tune the brake settings, delivers powerful, precise braking.
Microshift H104 Advent X 10S 11/48 cassette
KMC X10-1 116 link chain
Miranda 40 T Chainflow 3D Chainflow aluminium crankset; Crank length:; XS/S - 165 mm; M/L - 172.5 mm; XL/XXL - 175 mm
Microshift SWORD 1x10 0 RD-7005M rear derailleur

The GRVL AF fork is made of carbon for rigidity and propulsion, with an aluminium pivot to guarantee sturdiness.; Two side inserts enable you to attach extra bags or bottle carriers to set off on an adventure.

The GRVL AF 31.8 mm diameter handlebars are made from 6061 T6 aluminium.; The 16º flare is ideal for gravel riding, for a comfortable ride and good manoeuvrability.; Handlebar width depends on bike size:; XS - 400 mm; S - 420 mm; M/L - 440 mm; XL/XXL - 460 mm; The reach is 70mm and the drop 130mm.; max:3.5 bar/51 psi
6069 aluminium rims; Internal width 27mm; External width 31.4mm; Rim height 19 mm
DECATHLON COMFORT 30º saddle; Width:155 mm; Length: 250 mm; Steel clamp

B'TWIN 6061 T6 aluminium seat post; Diameter:27.2 mm; Height:; XS/S: 300 mm; M/L/XL: 350 mm; XXL: 400 mm; The natural flex of the seat post (thanks to its 27.2 diameter) filters vibrations and impacts for greater comfort
Microshift SWORD 1x10 shifter
28 spokes; Centerlock axle
The stem is made from 6061 T6 7º/ -7º aluminium; Stem length according to bike size:XS - 60 mm; S - 70 mm; M - 80 mm; L - 90 mm; XL/XXL - 100 mm
Hutchinson Touareg 40x700mm tyres; Weight 490 g per tyre.; The tyres are fitted with an inner tube but can be switched to tubeless with valves ref 8551979 and sealant ref. 8363393
min:2.5 bar/38 psi
Prowheel PW-BB68+; 1,877 g
